name: Murree
description: Cool pine ridges of the Galiyat, close enough to Lahore for a long weekend away.
lead: Pine ridges and cool air, a long weekend from Lahore

image.alt: Pine-covered ridges of the Galiyat at dusk, with monsoon cloud filling the valleys below

overview.headline: Cool air, a long weekend away
paragraphs: Murree and the Galiyat run along a ridge of pine forest an hour above Islamabad, in the foothills of the Himalaya. For families in Lahore, it is the closest escape from the summer heat.

Most visitors stay on Mall Road. We stay further along the ridge at Nathia Gali, where the walks are quieter: the Pipeline Track to Ayubia, and the climb to Mushkpuri Top for views across to the Kashmir peaks.

seasons.text: Fresh green ridges, 15–22°C. Quieter on weekdays.
An escape from the plains heat, 20–28°C. Monsoon rain in July and August.
Snow from December to February. Roads can close and traffic is heavy; nights below 0°C.

gettingThere.byRoad: Motorway M-2 to Islamabad, then the Murree Expressway.
